scope: Strict response contract for the private location-scoped business model canvas list.

constraints.extra_fields: forbidden at list, canvas, and content-block levels
constraints.content_blocks: the nine JSONB block keys explicitly built by the SQL function; each value remains JSON-compatible to preserve existing content
constraints.canvas_name: nullable, maximum 255 characters as defined by the table
constraints.schema_version: nullable, maximum 50 characters as defined by the table
constraints.health_score: finite numeric value between 0 and 100, matching the table check
constraints.request_binding: response location and offset must match request; returned rows cannot exceed requested limit
constraints.pagination: next_offset and has_more must agree; continuation is suppressed when the next page would exceed offset 10000

error_contract.invalid_projection: sanitized 500 with Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie

limitations: The response contract validates the existing SQL projection and does not establish populated-data parity, live OIDC behavior, or broader tenant isolation.
The nine content block values remain arbitrary JSON as stored in JSONB; semantic correctness of their nested content is not asserted by this route model.
